extracted.intended_audience: HHS awarding agencies, grant administrators, recipients of HHS financial assistance (including institutions of higher education, hospitals, nonprofit and for-profit recipients), and grants compliance officers
extracted.subtask_description: Interim final rule adopting OMB's Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles, and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards (2 CFR part 200) into HHS regulations (2 CFR part 300), describing HHS-specific modifications, effective dates, and procedural/analytical findings. Intended to instruct HHS agencies and recipients how HHS will implement and reference uniform grant requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Adoption of 2 CFR part 200 (Uniform Guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: HHS adopts OMB's Uniform Administrative Requirements, Cost Principles, and Audit Requirements for Federal Awards (2 CFR part 200) in its entirety, relocating HHS-specific modifications into 2 CFR part 300.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HHS will adopt 2 CFR part 200 to reduce burden, align HHS requirements with other Federal awarding agencies, and promote uniformity. Most provisions effective October 1, 2025; select provisions effective October 1, 2024. Where conflicts exist, HHS adopts OMB language to ensure consistency and least burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.106 — Adoption of 2 CFR part 200 (codification)
rubrics_metrics.description: Codifies HHS adoption of 2 CFR part 200 in HHS regulations (moved from prior 2 CFR 300.1).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a formal recodification to place the uniform guidance within HHS regulatory text (2 CFR part 300) while minimizing HHS-specific deviations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.112 — Conflict of Interest (supplementary requirements)
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes supplementary conflict of interest requirements and directs Public Health Service recipients to align conflict of interest policies with requirements in 42 CFR part 50, subpart F (moved from 45 CFR 75.112).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HHS retains supplementary conflict of interest rules applicable to PHS recipients even while adopting OMB language; recipients should follow 42 CFR part 50, subpart F where indicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.218 — Special provisions for awards to for-profit organizations
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains specific requirements for awards to for-profit organizations, including the prohibition against profit and program income requirements for SBIR/STTR programs (previously at 45 CFR 75.216 and 75.322(f)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies special restrictions (e.g., no-profit, program income rules) for for-profit recipients and SBIR/STTR programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.219 — Special provisions for awards to Federal agencies
rubrics_metrics.description: Contains specific requirements for awards to Federal agencies, such as program income requirements and salary and indirect cost restrictions (previously at 45 CFR 75.217).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Federal agencies as recipients remain subject to specified limitations on program income, salaries, and indirect costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.300 — Nondiscrimination language (HHS-specific)
rubrics_metrics.description: Includes HHS-specific nondiscrimination requirements (previously codified at 45 CFR 75.300).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HHS nondiscrimination provisions are retained and moved into part 300; recipients should comply with the specified nondiscrimination obligations.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.305 — Federal Payment (payments to States)
rubrics_metrics.description: Addresses federal payment provisions and rules for payments to States (moved from 45 CFR 75.305(a)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies HHS treatment of federal payments to states consistent with uniform guidance but retaining particular HHS formulations where needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.308 — Revision of budget and program plans (prior approval requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: Requires prior approval for research patient care costs (previously codified at 45 CFR 75.308(c)(1)(ix)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HHS retains a prior-approval requirement specifically for research patient care costs; note HHS is not repromulgating two other prior-approval provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.315 — Intangible property (protection of recipient patent rights)
rubrics_metrics.description: Prohibits HHS from asserting rights in inventions under awards made for primarily educational purposes (moved from 45 CFR 75.307(c)(2)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protects recipient patent rights in educational-award contexts; aligns with prior HHS practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.414 — Indirect costs (limits and exceptions)
rubrics_metrics.description: Limits indirect costs on training awards, awards to foreign organizations, and awards to foreign public entities performed fully outside the US to a fixed rate of 8% of MTDC; allows negotiated indirect cost rates for American University, Beirut and WHO (previously at 45 CFR 75.414(c)(1)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies fixed 8% MTDC cap for specific award types and permits negotiated exceptions only as listed; intended to limit indirect cost recovery on certain awards.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.477 — Independent research and development costs
rubrics_metrics.description: Defines and describes requirements for independent research and development costs (moved from 45 CFR 75.476).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sets HHS-specific treatment and allowability rules for IR&D costs; moved to part 300 but not substantively changed.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR 300.478 — Shared responsibility payments
rubrics_metrics.description: Describes requirements for payments for failure to maintain minimum essential health coverage and failure to offer health coverage to employees (moved from 45 CFR 75.477).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies treatment of shared responsibility payments under HHS awards consistent with prior HHS regulation.

rubrics_metrics.name: 2 CFR part 300, Appendix IX — Principles for determining R&D costs for hospitals
rubrics_metrics.description: Transfers Appendix IX (Principles for Determining Costs Applicable to Research and Development Under Grants and Contracts with Hospitals) from 45 CFR part 75 to 2 CFR part 300, appendix IX.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Preserves existing principles for hospital R&D cost determinations; codified in part 300 appendix for continuity.

rubrics_metrics.name: Good Cause Exception to notice-and-comment (5 U.S.C. 553(b)(B) and (d)(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: HHS finds good cause to dispense with advance notice and comment for this interim final rule where notice and comment are unnecessary, impracticable, or contrary to the public interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HHS relies on prior extensive OMB public processes (2012, 2013, 2020, 2023–2024) and concludes additional HHS-level notice would be duplicative and inefficient for many provisions; will accept comments limited to HHS plan/timeline for implementation within 30 days but will not respond to comments on OMB's 2020/2024 modifications or existing HHS provisions simply being moved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effective dates (two-tier effective dates)
rubrics_metrics.description: Most provisions are effective October 1, 2025; eight specified provisions are effective October 1, 2024 (and one amendatory instruction effective Oct 1, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Select provisions implementing increased flexibilities (see individual items) take effect earlier to avoid inequities and to allow HHS recipients to access the same flexibilities other agencies provide.

rubrics_metrics.name: Micro-purchase and simplified acquisition thresholds (2 CFR 200.320)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopts micro-purchase and simplified acquisition thresholds as required by Pub. L. 115-91 and OMB Memorandum 18-18 (effective Oct. 1, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These thresholds increase procurement flexibility consistent with statutory/OMB direction and were sought by the regulated community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Closeout procedures (2 CFR 200.344)
rubrics_metrics.description: Aligns HHS closeout rules with the Uniform Guidance closeout provision (effective Oct. 1, 2024 for closeout-related items adopted earlier), replacing prior HHS-specific closeout changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HHS will eliminate prior HHS-specific closeout changes to align fully with 2 CFR 200.344 to reduce administrative burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subaward threshold for Modified Total Direct Cost (MTDC) (2 CFR 200.1)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopts OMB's subaward threshold calculation for MTDC (effective Oct. 1, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Change adjusts the dollar threshold that governs which transactions are subawards vs. procurement to align with OMB updates and recipient requests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equipment threshold (2 CFR 200.1; 2 CFR 200.313(e))
rubrics_metrics.description: Raises the equipment threshold as modified by OMB (effective Oct. 1, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Higher equipment threshold increases flexibility for property management and procurement consistent with inflation and community input.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplies threshold (2 CFR 200.1; 2 CFR 200.314(a))
rubrics_metrics.description: Updates supplies threshold per OMB revisions (effective Oct. 1, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adjusts the level at which purchases are treated as supplies vs. equipment, reducing administrative burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fixed amount subaward threshold (2 CFR 200.333)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopts a fixed-amount subaward threshold as provided by OMB (effective Oct. 1, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Allows use of fixed-amount subawards up to specified threshold to simplify award administration.

rubrics_metrics.name: De minimis indirect cost rate (2 CFR 200.414(f))
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopts OMB's de minimis indirect cost rate provisions allowing a de minimis rate (effective Oct. 1, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides recipients an option to elect a de minimis indirect cost rate where appropriate, reducing negotiation burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audit threshold (2 CFR 200.501)
rubrics_metrics.description: Adopts OMB's revised single audit threshold (effective Oct. 1, 2024).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Raises the dollar threshold for audit requirements, decreasing audit burden for smaller recipients consistent with OMB updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public comment submission requirements and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments must be received electronically via www.regulations.gov no later than midnight EDT on November 1, 2024. HHS will consider comments on HHS's plan and timeline for implementation; will not respond to comments on OMB's 2020 or 2024 modifications or content of HHS-specific modifications that are existing regulations being moved.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies review submissions and may redact/withhold portions; HHS reserves the right not to respond to comments outside the limited scope identified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulatory Flexibility Act (RFA) certification
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the RFA (5 U.S.C. 601 et seq.), HHS must provide a final regulatory flexibility analysis or certify that the rule will not have a significant economic impact on a substantial number of small entities; HHS certifies the rule will not have such an impact.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HHS states the IFR streamlines processes and reduces administrative burden overall; while some revisions may impose non-significant burdens, net burden reduction is greater.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) review
rubrics_metrics.description: HHS reviewed the interim final rule under the PRA and determined there are no new collections of information contained in the rule.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adoption of Uniform Guidance may have negligible effects on burden estimates for existing information collections, but no new collections are introduced by this IFR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unfunded Mandates Reform Act (UMRA) assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: UMRA requires agencies to prepare an assessment if a rule exceeds a statutory cost threshold; HHS determined the interim final rule would not result in expenditures in excess of that statutory threshold.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No written UMRA statement required because the rule does not cross the threshold for state/local/tribal or private sector expenditures in any one year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Executive Orders and OIRA regulatory review requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Executive Orders (12866, 13563, 14094) require assessment of all costs and benefits and selection of regulatory approaches that maximize net benefits; OIRA determined this IFR is not a significant regulatory action under section 3(f)(1) but designated it a significant regulatory action under section 3(f) of EO 12866.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: HHS analyzed alternatives and concluded the single set of requirements at 2 CFR parts 200 and 300 will lessen confusion and administrative burden; OIRA review status and designation are noted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Preservation and migration of existing HHS policies to HHS Grants Policy Statement (GPS)
rubrics_metrics.description: HHS will move certain provisions better suited for sub-regulatory guidance (e.g., specific HHS forms, HHS property policy, metric system provision) to the HHS Grants Policy Statement rather than re-codify them in regulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy items that are administrative or procedural will be retained but moved to GPS to avoid unnecessary regulatory codification and maintain flexibility.
